notes: #16 (1759 optical print of the cathedral) skipped: it shows a two-tower design with the main spire, which was not built until 1762–74, so it is not a view of the real building. #12 (Vue de Milan, 1812–14) is a minor square in an optical print. #15: record date 1842, but the file also sits in the category 1834 in Milan; Inganni painted several versions of this view. #24 is a map of ancient Mediolanum, not a period view.
